tasks.label: Publish Lakehouse bundle
tasks.detail: Publish the bundle NB_dbt_Runner_Spark runs (dbt project + dbt_packages, dbt-fabricspark, jaffle-dbt-runner + deps the runtime lacks) to LH_Jaffle_Shop Files/dbt/jaffle_shop.zip in the chosen workspace. Runs from .venv-tools (tools\setup-env.ps1 -Target tools).

tasks.label: Assemble Lakehouse bundle (no upload)
tasks.detail: What CI does: resolve against the Runtime 2.0 manifest and build build/bundle/jaffle_shop.zip + deployment.json locally, without authenticating or uploading.

tasks.label: Tool and runner unit tests
tasks.detail: pytest over tools/tests and runner/tests (pytest.ini). No dbt or Fabric needed.

tasks.label: Refresh Fabric runtime constraints
tasks.detail: Regenerate tools/runtime_constraints/fabric-runtime-2.0-python313.txt from Microsoft's runtime manifest (no-op until the manifest changes). Republish the bundle afterwards.
